Callout.Name: Contraband Drop - Coast Road
Callout.Message: Contraband believed to be landing on the coast road.
Callout.Advisory: Vehicle waiting on the verge with its lights off.

Script.Line: I am waiting for the tide. I fish off this road.
The lights are off to keep the battery for the morning.
Nothing has come in tonight. Nothing and nobody.

Lines.Approach: A van with its lights off on the coast road at two in the morning. Nobody does that for the view.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
